games.title: Dark Souls III
games.description: The fire is fading. Darkness creeps across the land. The Lords of Cinder charged with watching over the First Flame have abandoned their thrones. The Champion of Ash, an undead is chosen to return them to their thrones.

games.title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
games.description: Set in a reimagining of 1500s Sengoku era Japan. An unnamed shinobi, tasked with protecting a young lord of mystical lineage, who is left for dead when a powerful samurai attacks and chops off his arm.

games.title: Overwatch 2
games.description: Overwatch 2 is a team-based multiplayer shooter offering engaging gameplay and a polished experience for PC players.
